headline: Approval of grants including $283,355.40 STEM equipment grant and $100,000 PlayBall Foundation sports grant; superintendent evaluation.
summary: The agenda includes several grant and finance approvals, along with budget review and audit reports. It also covers a contract for the Director of Nursing and an update on the Superintendent's annual goals.
items: Executive session: workers' compensation settlement for cafeteria manager
Executive session: workers' compensation settlement for cafeteria worker
Executive session: contract negotiations with Director of Nursing-elect Amy Grniet
Executive session: review of executive session minutes from June 4, 2026
Consent agenda: donations from Benchmark Senior Living, University of Wisconsin ($1000), Worcester Educational Development Foundation ($2,585), and UMass Med
Consent agenda: notification of new hire instructional staff, new hire non-instructional staff, and resignations/retirements
Presentation on the 2025-2026 annual goals of the Superintendent and Superintendent Self-Assessment 2026
Approval of DES grant FY 27 FC426 CTE Frameworks and Competency Based Implementation ($80,000)
Approval of National Education Association grant "Envision Equity" ($2,500)
Approval of PlayBall Foundation grant for 2026-2027 Middle School sports ($100,000)
Approval of 4 prior year payments ($18,090.65)
Approval of STEM Equipment and Professional Development Grant ($283,355.40)
Approval of prior year payment to AA Transportation ($950.00)
Update on City of Worcester IT Department moving out of Worcester Technical High School
Update on Safe Schools LGBTQIA training/programming
Update on WPS Homework Policy, one year after implementation
Review of FY27 Budget status and transfers
Review of Student Activity fund testing report for fiscal year ending June 30, 2026
Review of Independent Accountants' Report on agreed-upon procedures for DESE end of year, fiscal year ending June 30, 2026
Review of annual audit and compliance reports for the City of Worcester, including Worcester Public Schools, for fiscal year ending June 30, 2026
Request for four-month lead time for curriculum, contract, or policy changes needing School Committee approval
Set date and approve process for Superintendent Evaluation
Vote to execute employment contract with Amy Grniet as Director of Nursing, July 16, 2026, through June 30, 2029
Authorize three-year Software License and Services Agreement with Renaissance Learning, Inc. for reading, mathematics, and early literacy instruction
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall
